body:
## Change

F1. Await all started Story slot clears before reporting reset failure. Prevent reset promise settling while another destructive clear still runs; retain original rejection reason.

## Validation

V1. Behavioral RED/GREEN injects one failing clear plus one delayed clear. Parent reviewed settlement ordering and synthetic repository, reran 28 admin unit/component tests. Worker contracts: 87; typecheck, targeted lint/format/diff passed. No actual app data reset.

## Limits

L1. Multi-slot reset remains non-atomic; failures can leave partially cleared slots. First rejected result in slot order is reported after all settle. No native browser storage timing proof. Full CI has sampled acquisition failures; no full-CI-green claim.
title: fix(shell): settle all started story clears before reset returns
